claim: Personenschifffahrt Gebr. Kolb runs Mosel cruises in the Bernkastel region from 1 May to 17 Oct 2026 (break 7-17 June) on Tue/Thu/Sat with additional Weds in Aug-Sep; one route is Leiwen-Bernkastel with arrival noon and return at 3pm; adult return 27€ one way 20€.
quote: Schedule runs from 1 May to 6 June and 18 June to 17 October 2026, operating on Tuesdays, Thursdays and Saturdays... Adults return trip: 27 €, Adults one way: 20 €, Groups of 10 or more receive 10% discount, and children 6-14 years pay half price.

claim: Personenschifffahrt Gebrüder Kolb is the main operator from Bernkastel-Kues offering one-hour panorama cruises plus longer trips to Traben-Trarbach (2 hours), Alf, and from Leiwen, with themed evening, wine-festival, Advent and BBQ cruises.
quote: Personenschifffahrt Gebrüder Kolb (Gebrüder Kolb Passenger Boat Company) operates the main boat tours from Bernkastel-Kues. Round trips: One-hour panorama cruises departing from Bernkastel. Half-day/day trips: Bernkastel-Kues to Traben-Trarbach (2 hours), Bernkastel-Kues to Alf, Leiwen to Bernkastel-Kues.

claim: Daily Traben-Trarbach to Bernkastel-Kues round-trips run May-October with ~2-hour journey time; adult return 25€, one-way 20€, kids 6-14 half-price, bikes carried on board.
quote: From May to October, several daily scheduled trips operate from Traben-Trarbach to Bernkastel-Kues and back with a journey time of approximately 2 hours... adults return trip for 25€, adults one way for 20€... Bicycles can be taken on board.

claim: Moselradweg Stage 5 (Piesport to Bernkastel-Kues) is 18.5 km along the right bank, mostly flat, passing the Moselloreley rock and wine villages Wintrich, Brauneberg, Mülheim.
quote: The 18.5-kilometre-long cycle tour begins with a view of the natural monument 'Moselloreley', a rock massif rising steeply out of the Moselle. Downstream, the route takes you along vineyards, orchards and picturesque winegrowing villages such as Wintrich, Brauneberg and Mülheim.

claim: Piesport-Bernkastel cycling stage is 18.3 km, ~1h15min easy ride, only 2 m ascent and 16 m descent, altitudes 105-123 m.
quote: Distance: 18.3 km, Duration: 1 hour 15 minutes, Difficulty: Easy, Elevation: Only 2m ascent, 16m descent (ranging from 105m to 123m)

claim: The Moselradweg German section is 248 km from Perl to Koblenz, mostly asphalted and separated from roads, relatively flat, certified as an ADFC 4-star quality cycle route as of 2024.
quote: The German section spans '248 kilometres' from Perl in Saarland to Koblenz... mostly asphalted and run separately from the main roads with relatively flat and without major gradients... ADFC quality cycle route with 4 stars status.

claim: The Bernkastel-Kues holiday region has 13 bike and e-bike borrowing stations, with notable shops including Fun Bike Team (Bernkastel-Kues), Velodocs (Zeltingen-Rachtig), Peter Später (Piesport), and tourist-info-based rentals in Wintrich and Brauneberg.
quote: Fun Bike Team GmbH - Bernkastel-Kues... Bicycle rental Peter Später - Piesport... Tourist Information Brauneberg... The region has '13 borrowing stations' and '7 repair stations' overall.

claim: In Piesport, Fahrradverleih Peter Später (Römerstraße 43, +49 6507 939350) and Altes Kelterhaus (St.-Martin-Straße 33) rent bikes; the Tourist Information has a battery charging station for e-bikes.
quote: Fahrradverleih Peter Später, Römerstraße 43, Tel +49 6507 939 350; Altes Kelterhaus, St.-Martin-Straße 33; Tourist Information Piesport has a battery charging station for electric bikes

claim: Mosel-Kanu-Service in Piesport (Römerstraße 38, +49 6507 5558) rents canoes and kayaks for day or multi-day paddling in the Piesport Mosel loop and Wintrich barrage reservoir; opening times depend on weather.
quote: Location: Piesport, Germany (Römerstraße 38, 54498 Piesport). Phone: +49 6507 5558... The outfit specializes in the Piesport Moselle loop and the Wintrich barrage reservoir area... Opening times vary based on weather conditions.

claim: Mosel-Kanuverleih in Reil (Moselstraße 13, 56861 Reil/Mosel) rents kayaks and canoes from €20, SUP from €10, full-day tours €25-35+, season mid-May through October; life jackets mandatory and included free; multi-day and guided tours available.
quote: Kayaks: From €20; Canoes: From €20; SUP (Stand-Up Paddle): From €10; Full-day tours: €25-€35+; Season: Mid-May through October; 'Wearing a life jacket is mandatory when renting a canoe' and provided free of charge.

claim: Operating Mosel ferries near Trier include the electric Sankta Maria II Oberbillig-Wasserbillig (passengers €1, bikes €1.80, cars €3) and seasonal passenger ferries at Enkirch-Kövenig and Pünderich (€2-2.50, bikes €1.50); historic Wintrich/Köwerich/Brauneberg car ferries no longer run.
quote: Sankta Maria II (electric ferry): Mon-Fri 6:30-13:30; Sat-Sun & holidays 11-17. Prices: Passengers €1, bikes €1.80, cars €3... Enkirch-Kövenig: Easter-end Oct, Wed-Sun... Prices: €2.50 (10+), bikes €1.50

claim: The Burg-Landshut-Express in Bernkastel-Kues is a panoramic shuttle bus (not a chairlift) running every full hour from the Mosel parking lot to the castle ruins, April-October; operator Bustouristik Feuerer (06531-8005).
quote: This is a shuttle/bus service, not a chairlift... Departures: Every full hour from the Mosel parking lot. Seasonal operation: April through October. Bustouristik Feuerer Tel: 06531-8005 or 06531-6144.

claim: Waldkletterpark Wald Abenteuer Leiwen (Sonnenberg 1, 54340 Leiwen) sits in the Landal Sonnenberg resort ~20 min from Trier with adult Adventure ticket €29, under-18 €25, kids' parcours €18; minimum 140cm/11yrs for adult course; online booking with no cancellation fees.
quote: Sonnenberg 1, 54340 Leiwen, Germany. The park is situated within the Landal Sonnenberg holiday resort, approximately 20 minutes from Trier. Kinder-Parcours: €18.00; Adventure-Parcours (under 18): €25.00; Adventure-Parcours (18+): €29.00.
